title: Zeros or X-Intercepts
text: A rational function is zero when its numerator is zero and its denominator is nonzero. Set $$x=0$$ and verify the denominator is not zero.

title: Domain
text: The function is undefined when $$x^2-16=0$$, so exclude $$x=-4$$ and $$x=4$$ from the domain.

title: Range
text: To test the range, solve $$y=\frac{x}{x^2-16}$$ for $$x$$. The discriminant $$1+64y^2$$ is positive for every real $$y$$.
